payload.title: File:Huanansaurus (Corythoraptor) Size Comparison.svg
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of the holotype specimen(s) of Huanansaurus ganzhouensis (HGM41HIII-0443) and "Corythoraptor jacobsi" (JPM-2015-001)—which are effectively identical in size and potentially synonymous—with an adult human male (~1.8 m) for reference.

References

  • "A new oviraptorid dinosaur (Dinosauria: Oviraptorosauria) from the Late Cretaceous of Southern China and its paleobiogeographical Implications"
  • "High diversity of the Ganzhou Oviraptorid Fauna increased by a new "cassowary-like" crested species"
  • "A new oviraptorid theropod fossil from the Upper Cretaceous of Southern China with implications for oviraptorosaurian systematics and palaeobiogeography"
